name: Yarrow
source:
The lone resident of Yarrow Valley, this touchy-feely alien was delighted when Havi first landed and is always sad to see him go. He's an outcast among his species.

Likes: physical contact, spending time outdoors
Dislikes: being left alone, doing nothing

[From [url=https://arcadeparty.itch.io/yarrow-valley]itch.io[/url]]
